purpose: Validation-only preflight of the official MambaTS VPT python-tsp local-search route against the local greedy VPT control and strong same-source baselines.
research_question: Does replacing the local greedy VPT evaluation route with the official MambaTS-style train-cost ATSP local-search route improve MambaTSv11 AutoCon forecasting on Weather and ETTh1 H96?
architecture: Both VPT arms use one shared Mamba-1 scan, per-sample random variable paths during training, detached prediction-loss transition costs, channel restoration, and prediction-connected AutoCon representation fusion. Only the validation/evaluation route solver differs: greedy versus python-tsp local search.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only. No test metrics are generated or inspected. This is a local implementation of the public MambaTS VPT route with python-tsp, not a claim of bitwise equivalence to the external repository.
claim_boundary: A pass only supports a separately registered held-out release. It cannot establish universal VPT, Mamba, or AutoCon superiority.

required_before_launch: verify ETTh1 and Weather hashes and exact 42-job expansion
freeze VPT architecture and solver-only paired contrast
run all phases under the immutable launch sidecar
preserve source snapshot and output root

pairing_contract.interpretation: This isolates the VPT evaluation solver; all training components, paths, seeds, and losses are identical.

stopping_rules: Stop the VPT-LS branch if it fails to improve the greedy control on at least two of three paired seeds in both datasets.
Stop a dataset branch if VPT-LS is more than 2% worse than the strongest registered external reference.
Do not release held-out test from a failed coordinate.
